author: mark
text:
Phase 3: v0.3 prompt path migration

Re-wires `lernie prompt` against the v0.3 conv-repo layout introduced in
Phase 2 (bl-ecda):

- Branch naming: drops the `ex/` prefix; root conversation runs on a
  bare `<conv-id>` branch, hyphenated descent (ARCH §2.3).
- Worktree path: `<conv-repo>/<conv-id>/` as a sibling of `root/` —
  not `<conv-repo>/.lernie/worktrees/ex/<id>/` (ARCH §2.2).
- Step path: `steps/<conv-id>/<NNN>/` (namespaced by conv-id for
  collision-free merge into parent worktrees).
- Goal+soul committed at the worktree root as part of the dispatch
  snapshot; `.agent/goal.md` retired (ARCH §2.8, §4.3).
- Config wiring: per-repo `<conv-repo>/providers.yaml` (`roles:` only)
  + global `<harness-root>/providers.yaml` via `ProvidersConfig::load`
  (ARCH §4.1, §4.3); soul read from `<conv-repo>/souls/<role>.md`.
- Compactor: drops `inv/` prefix; cmp branch = `<parent-conv-id>-<cmp-id>`
  hyphenated descent; summary at `summary/<NNN>.md`; runs git ops
  inside the parent worktree (which shares the .git dir) since the
  conv-repo root itself is not a git checkout in v0.3.
- `lernie prompt` resolves the harness root via `harness_root::resolve`
  and threads it through `Deps::harness_root`.
- ARCH §2.3 paragraph 2: clarified — the conversation-repo's `main`
  branch is the durable home of root-conversation history; each user
  message spawns a `<conv-id>` branch off the current `main` tip and
  merges back on completion (paragraph 3 is the load-bearing rule).
- README "Sending a prompt" rewritten for the v0.3 shape; integration
  test re-enabled under the new layout; tarpaulin per-test timeout
  bumped to accommodate the subprocess-chain test under instrumentation.
- All tests green, 100% coverage, fmt/lint clean.

Out of scope (later balls): tool support (next v0.3 phase), agents.yaml
retirement (Phase 4), v0.3-shape detection in the UI (`fs_watcher` and
`git_tree` still target v0.1/v0.2 paths), schema regen (Phase 6),
subagent dispatch (v0.4 / bl-683c).

Notes for the spec:
- ARCH §2.3 step 5 still says "Root: no merge" — contradicts the
  load-bearing rule in paragraph 3 and the implementation. Brief
  authorized only paragraph 2 wording, so left untouched. Worth a
  follow-on fixup.
- ARCH §8 metric prose ("Root conversations are intentionally
  unmerged") inherits the same stale framing; the metric command
  itself (`git branch --list '*-*' --no-merged main`) correctly
  enumerates both root and subagent branches.
